required slots: restaurant name,location,time

optional slots: price range,has vegetarian options,has seating outdoors

System: Sure thing. What city would you like me to search in? Do you have any particular type of food you were thinking about?
User: Yeah, I could really go for some Punjabi right now. Can you find me something in San Carlos?
